label: No being other than an actual root is required by that root's own end
paraphrase: OPEN (SS, analyst formulation, unattributed): for every actual root n of the selected grounding relation G at w and every being x other than n, x is not required by n's own end (EndRequires). The self-sufficiency of the root's good (ST I q.19 a.3 co., navigation only: 'His goodness can be without other things'). Avicenna's First is self-sufficient in the same sense; the emanationist rival denies WN, not SS.
